page.title: The Tushar Shaw Lab team.
page.intro: The Tushar Shaw Lab brings together a principal investigator, research staff, student interns, and alumni at M.S. Ramaiah University of Applied Sciences (RUAS), Bengaluru, India.
page.sectionIntro: The team studies infectious diseases and bacterial pathogens, developing rapid, reliable, and cost-effective diagnostics.
